verdict.rationale: Latham's Book of Jargon glossary explicitly lists founder-equity terms like '83(b) Election,' 'Cliff Vesting,' and 'Vesting Schedule,' and LathamDrive offers a formation document generator, showing some coverage of the mechanics vocabulary and tooling a founder would need. However, these are glossary definitions and a generic document generator, not substantive firm guidance explaining vesting schedule structuring, 83(b) filing process, or how to split equity among co-founders. Missing for 10: dedicated explainer content or templates on vesting schedule design, step-by-step 83(b) election guidance, and founder equity-split methodology/frameworks.
